purpose: Test whether actual factory exit and local assembly improve opening participation, holding the economy and contact policy fixed

decision.budget: 32 starts, inspect all results before selecting another candidate
decision.mechanism: Verify departure and four-tank participation on the first short-map candidate replay and compare the first baseline replay; this is factual reconstruction, not matched counterfactual evidence
decision.cost: Check other complete-game cells for the cost of waiting, preserving every limit and error
decision.next: Retain only an informative change; a candidate with useful evidence must still face a fresh fixed comparison including M0, counter, external Supalosa and the third development map before release
